title: The sequencing report rebuilt one page per test from the instruments database; the islands floor route corrects the counted readings; the atlas molecule files go to Zenodo
set_out: Rebuild the sequencing report so a researcher can read every test; draw every globe and sphere reading as a sphere under its test; ship the full derivation linked step by step; correct the counted islands readings for each laboratory's own non-conversion; deposit the atlas molecule files on Zenodo.
open_at_turnover: Chain edit for the islands floor route, megakaryocytes and far-island counts (written and dry-run, not yet sent); depth-free C-Score; held-out healthy ranges; 'where' re-planted and printed; lung and liver reports; the page-by-page check and the outside-reader audit; sign-off; the leukemia study; the last 18 Zenodo archives after a quota increase.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Laboratory correction test reads (edit 246)
entries.what: Planted 1 % non-conversion and the unplanted known-answer library through the one button on main.
entries.outcome: Molecule-counted readings corrected (Law Sphere strays x1.04, unused islands x1.05, clock gain x1.03); counted islands readings not (islands territory x2.77).
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (GSE186458); test library GSM5652214

entries.title: Islands floor route, four reads
entries.what: The chain's existing route (floors of the sample and the reference counted at the islands read, both read at the higher) on the planted and unplanted library.
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (GSE186458); test library GSM5652214

entries.title: Islands floor route, 31 never-used healthy libraries
entries.what: Each read twice on main, with and without the route.
entries.outcome: Islands territory centre 1.021 -> 1.010, spread 0.154 -> 0.060; the 26 other readings identical (F283).

entries.title: Depth check
entries.what: Each reading's correlation with the molecules read, over the never-used libraries.
entries.outcome: The IAM-A C-Score, the Law Sphere halves and the islands territory follow read depth (F281); depth-free forms owed.

entries.title: Full-output reads
entries.what: The known-answer, whole lung and whole liver libraries read keeping every output file (globe, spheres, explorer, counts).
entries.outcome: All three read; their pictures feed the report.
entries.reference: IAM Sequencing Atlas (GSE186458); GSM5652214, GSM2103014, GSM2103010

entries.title: Far-island counts
entries.what: Per-island counts at the 8,567 unused islands with the chain's own counter, for the three libraries.
entries.outcome: Totals match the chain's own unused-island reading exactly (GSM5652214: 96,848 calls off the array, stray 0.012132).

entries.title: Sequencing report, five builds
entries.what: Built on Google from the instruments database, line by line: score page, one page per test, every reading and input, globes and spheres under their readings, contents and glossary, supplement S3 printed and linked.
entries.outcome: 213 pages; 296 of 296 database rows printed; no process history; every 'step N' links into S3.

entries.title: Methods check
entries.what: Every credited method searched for in the chain's code on main.
entries.outcome: Each method now classed by where it is used; array-only and unused methods left out of the report's methods table; two credits corrected.

entries.title: Zenodo deposit
entries.what: The 205 molecule files of the Sequencing Atlas, one archive per cell type, uploaded from a Google machine to an unpublished draft.
entries.outcome: 62 of 80 archives (49.2 GB) in; the record's 50 GB limit reached; the rest wait for a quota increase.
